Within-study bias.note: Contribution-weighted RoB-2 of the tirz + sema trials; panel input (most industry-sponsored).

Reporting bias.note: Directly measured (our strongest domain): 6 ghosts identified, observed pull -0.12 pp (negligible); not funnel-inferred (registry_pubbias.json).

Indirectness.note: (a) Population applicability transported & quantified (POTH 0.898). (b) INDIRECT comparison: transitivity balanced on available modifiers but INCOMPLETE (baseline wt (kg), HbA1c (%) missing). NB any CV-benefit claim -> Major concerns (weight not a validated CV surrogate).

Imprecision.note: Indirect contrast 2.9 pp, 95% CrI [-0.14, 5.98] crosses null (conservative; exact NMA contrast narrower).

Heterogeneity.note: I^2 of contributing nodes ~94% (high BUT largely EXPLAINED by follow-up 44-104 wk / population; CINeMA does not downgrade to major for explained heterogeneity).

Incoherence.note: Star network: no direct tirz-vs-sema evidence and no closed loop -> direct-vs-indirect agreement cannot be tested.
